description: Windows packaging (Phase 2). Build the frontend into the backend fat jar, then produce and LAUNCH a self-contained jpackage app-image with a bundled Java runtime (no Java/Maven/Node needed by the installed app). Verify the packaged app end-to-end against its runtime port, with persistent data under %LOCALAPPDATA% (never inside the app-image dir). Attempt the real .exe installer: probe winget/choco/dotnet and WiX; since WiX v3 is NOT installed here, author the installer build script and document the installer as EXECUTION-BLOCKED, retaining the verified app-image. Depends on FEAT-001 (hardened runtime + dynamic paths).
steps: Build the web bundle into the jar: cd frontend; npm install; npm run build; copy frontend/dist/* into backend/src/main/resources/static/ preserving static/.gitkeep; cd backend; mvn clean package -DskipTests -> backend/target/qr-share-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar. Optionally add windows/build-jar.ps1 to script this.

Confirm the fat-jar Main-Class before jpackage: unzip backend/target/qr-share-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar META-INF/MANIFEST.MF and read Main-Class (Spring Boot 3.2 => org.springframework.boot.loader.launch.JarLauncher). Use the ACTUAL value as --main-class.

Create windows/build-app-image.ps1 that runs: jpackage --type app-image --name UniversalQRSharing --input backend\target --main-jar qr-share-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar --main-class org.springframework.boot.loader.launch.JarLauncher --dest release\windows --app-version 1.0.0 --vendor "Universal QR" --java-options "-Xmx512m" --win-console. Actually run it; fix errors (wrong main-class, stale dest dir).

Launch release\windows\UniversalQRSharing\UniversalQRSharing.exe as a BACKGROUND process; wait ~40s; verify /actuator/health UP, /api/network/info, /api/diagnostics against the packaged runtime port; upload+download+SHA-256 match+delete; confirm persistent data is under %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing and NOT inside the app-image directory; stop the app.

Attempt the real .exe installer: probe winget/choco/dotnet (record exact output). jpackage --type exe needs WiX v3 candle/light; WiX v4 dotnet tool is likely insufficient (state precisely). Do NOT install untrusted/destructive tooling. Confirmed here: WiX NOT installed, NSIS NOT installed => installer EXECUTION-BLOCKED; retain the app-image and document the exact manual step.

Create windows/build-installer.ps1: jpackage --type exe ... with --win-menu --win-shortcut --win-dir-chooser --win-menu-group "Universal QR Sharing" producing release\windows\UniversalQRSharing-1.0.0.exe. Document that binaries may live in Program Files but user data stays under %LOCALAPPDATA% (RuntimePaths guarantees this) and upgrades must preserve that data; uninstall must not silently destroy user shares/config.
acceptance_criteria: backend/target/qr-share-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar exists and, run with java -jar, serves the SPA at / (frontend bundled).

The launched app-image passes /actuator/health UP, upload/download SHA-256 match, delete 404, and keeps persistent data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing (verified NOT inside the app-image dir).
windows/build-installer.ps1 exists and is internally consistent; the installer is honestly documented as EXECUTION-BLOCKED (WiX v3 absent), not faked.
verification: cd frontend; npm run build  (exit 0); copy dist into backend static; cd backend; mvn clean package -DskipTests  (BUILD SUCCESS)
Read META-INF/MANIFEST.MF from the jar and confirm Main-Class.
Run windows/build-app-image.ps1; assert the packaged exe path exists.
Launch the packaged exe in the background; run the same live health/upload/download/SHA-256/delete checks as FEAT-001 against the packaged port; assert data path under %LOCALAPPDATA%; stop the app.
Run tool probes (winget/choco/dotnet, wix --version) and record exact output proving the installer is BLOCKED here.
findings: IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED on Windows 11 / JDK 25.0.4.1 (Temurin), jpackage + jlink present. (1) FRONTEND BUNDLE: cd frontend; npm run build (vite 5, exit 0, 1442 modules, dist/index.html + assets). Copied frontend/dist/* into backend/src/main/resources/static/ preserving static/.gitkeep (static/index.html + static/assets/ stay git-ignored, NOT committed). windows/build-jar.ps1 scripts npm build + static sync + mvn package. (2) FAT JAR: cd backend; mvn clean package -DskipTests => BUILD SUCCESS, backend/target/qr-share-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar (34,255,251 bytes). Smoke-run (java -jar, SERVER_PORT=8798): /actuator/health UP, GET / returns 200 with the SPA (<div id="root">). (3) MAIN-CLASS CONFIRMED from the jar's META-INF/MANIFEST.MF: Main-Class = org.springframework.boot.loader.launch.JarLauncher (Spring Boot 3.2 launcher), Start-Class = com.qrshare.QrShareApplication. ACTUAL --main-class used for jpackage = org.springframework.boot.loader.launch.JarLauncher. (4) APP-IMAGE: windows/build-app-image.ps1 runs jpackage --type app-image --name UniversalQRSharing --input release\jpackage-input (clean, jar-only staging so no stray target/ artifacts are bundled) --main-jar qr-share-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar --main-class org.springframework.boot.loader.launch.JarLauncher --dest release\windows --app-version 1.0.0 --vendor "Universal QR" --java-options -Xmx512m --win-console, PLUS --add-modules (see fix below). PRODUCED app-image path: release\windows\UniversalQRSharing\UniversalQRSharing.exe (self-contained: bundled runtime\ via jlink, app\qr-share-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar, UniversalQRSharing.cfg app.mainclass=JarLauncher). No system Java/Maven/Node needed to launch. (5) PACKAGING BUG FOUND & FIXED (not faked): first app-image launched and health was UP, but file upload returned HTTP 500. Root cause from captured stdout: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError com.google.zxing.common.StringUtils caused by java.nio.charset.UnsupportedCharsetException: EUC_JP -- jpackage's auto-derived jlink runtime omitted jdk.charsets, which ZXing references at class-init during QR generation. FIX: added --add-modules java.base,java.desktop,java.instrument,java.management,java.naming,java.net.http,java.prefs,java.rmi,java.scripting,java.security.jgss,java.sql,jdk.crypto.ec,jdk.unsupported,jdk.charsets,jdk.localedata,jdk.zipfs to the jpackage call. Rebuilt. This is a runtime-completeness fix only; nothing the user sees changed. (6) LIVE VERIFICATION of the REBUILT packaged exe (launched in background, SERVER_PORT=8788): /actuator/health = UP; /api/network/info localIp=172.20.10.2 (real LAN IP, not 127.0.0.1), port=8788, shareBaseUrl=http://172.20.10.2:8788, activeInterface 'Intel(R) Wi-Fi 7 BE201 320MHz'; /api/diagnostics appVersion=1.0.0, runtimePort=8788, lanIp=172.20.10.2, dataRoot=C:\Users\sunny\AppData\Local\UniversalQRSharing, filesDir=...\storage\files, storageWritable=true, freeDiskSpaceBytes populated, javaVersion=25.0.4.1, osName='Windows 11'. UPLOAD/DOWNLOAD/SHA-256/DELETE: POST /api/files returned id + shareUrl=http://172.20.10.2:8788/share/<token> + QR data:image/png;base64 (QR generation works post-fix); download via GET /api/files/share/<token> -> SHA-256 of downloaded bytes == source (C9A6333B...C0D8, MATCH); DELETE /api/files/<id> = 204; subsequent GET /api/files/share/<token> = 404. PERSISTENT DATA confirmed UNDER %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing\storage\files and NOT inside the app-image dir (Test-Path release\windows\UniversalQRSharing\storage = False, ...\app\storage = False). App stopped after verification. (7) REAL .EXE INSTALLER -- EXECUTION-BLOCKED (not faked). Tool probes (exact results): winget = FOUND (C:\Users\sunny\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\winget.exe); choco = NOT FOUND; dotnet = NOT FOUND; wix = NOT FOUND; candle (WiX v3) = NOT FOUND; light (WiX v3) = NOT FOUND; makensis (NSIS) = NOT FOUND. Actually ran jpackage --type exe to confirm the block; exact jpackage output: 'Can not find WiX tools. Was looking for WiX v3 light.exe and candle.exe or WiX v4/v5 wix.exe and none was found' then 'Error: Invalid or unsupported type: [exe]'. Did NOT install WiX/other tooling (out of scope; blocked env). The verified app-image is the shipped artifact here. (8) windows/build-installer.ps1 authored and internally consistent: jpackage --type exe with --win-menu --win-shortcut --win-dir-chooser --win-menu-group "Universal QR Sharing" (+ same --add-modules), output release\windows\UniversalQRSharing-1.0.0.exe; fails fast with an honest WiX-absent message when WiX is missing (verified it does exactly that here); documents that binaries may live in Program Files while user data stays under %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing (RuntimePaths guarantees this), upgrades preserve that data, and uninstall must not silently destroy user shares/config. (9) .gitignore: added release/ so packaging output (app-image, bundled runtime, installer, staging) is never committed; static/index.html + static/assets/ remain ignored. NEW FILES: windows/build-jar.ps1, windows/build-app-image.ps1, windows/build-installer.ps1.
